data.one_liner: Simple i18n solution using YAML files to generate compile-safe Dart translation classes.
data.what_it_does: Allows writing messages into YAML files and uses build_runner to generate convenient, compile-safe Dart classes with support for parameters and pluralization.
use_when: You want compile-time safety for your localization keys
You prefer calling methods instead of arbitrary strings for translations
You already use build_runner in your project
avoid_when: You prefer zero code generation and dynamic runtime loading
You want a fully-featured localization suite without writing custom plurals for unsupported languages
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation steps
Built-in plural rules are currently limited to English and Czech unless custom rules are added
data.setup_notes: Add build_runner as a dev_dependency and i18n as a dependency, then run the build_runner watch command.
